items.name: Amazon Athena
items.description: Serverless SQL query service for data in Amazon S3 and other sources.

items.name: Amazon Redshift
items.description: Cloud data warehouse from AWS that can also query open table formats in Amazon S3.

items.name: Apache Doris
items.description: Real-time analytical database that can also query data lakes directly.

items.name: Apache Drill
items.description: Schema-free SQL query engine for files, NoSQL stores and other self-describing data.

items.name: Apache Druid
items.description: Real-time analytics database for fast aggregations over streaming and historical event data.

items.name: Apache Impala
items.description: Distributed SQL query engine for data in HDFS, Apache Ozone and object stores.

items.name: Apache Kylin
items.description: OLAP engine that speeds up multidimensional analysis with precomputed cubes and indexes.

items.name: Apache Kyuubi
items.description: Multi-tenant gateway that serves SQL over Spark, Flink, Trino and other engines.

items.name: Apache Pinot
items.description: Real-time analytics database built for low-latency, user-facing queries.

items.name: ClickHouse
items.description: Column-oriented analytical database that can also query open table formats in object storage.

items.name: Databricks SQL
items.description: SQL warehouse on the Databricks lakehouse platform.

items.name: Dremio
items.description: Lakehouse platform and SQL query engine built around Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow.

items.name: Firebolt
items.description: Analytical data warehouse aimed at low-latency, high-concurrency queries.

items.name: Google BigQuery
items.description: Serverless data warehouse from Google Cloud that can also query open table formats.

items.name: Microsoft Fabric
items.description: Microsoft analytics platform that combines lakehouse, warehouse, data engineering and BI on OneLake.

items.name: MotherDuck
items.description: Managed cloud data warehouse built on DuckDB.

items.name: Presto
items.description: Distributed SQL query engine for querying data where it lives, hosted by the Linux Foundation's Presto Foundation.

items.name: SingleStore
items.description: Distributed SQL database that combines transactional and analytical workloads.

items.name: Snowflake
items.description: Cloud data platform with a SQL engine that works on its own storage and on Apache Iceberg tables.

items.name: Starburst
items.description: Commercial lakehouse platform built on Trino.

items.name: StarRocks
items.description: Distributed SQL engine for low-latency analytics on and off the data lakehouse, hosted by the Linux Foundation.

items.name: Trino
items.description: Distributed SQL query engine for querying data across lakes, warehouses and databases.

items.name: Apache DataFusion
items.description: Extensible query engine written in Rust on Apache Arrow, with SQL, DataFrame and Python APIs.

items.name: DuckDB
items.description: In-process analytical SQL database with first-class Python support and table-format extensions.
